plugins/fleet-core/skills/fleet-core.description: Shared rules for the clausona fleet skills (superset-fleet, herdr-fleet, orca-fleet, tmux-fleet). Load it only when one of those skills tells you to; it is not a task on its own.

plugins/herdr-fleet/skills/herdr-fleet.description: Run several coding agents in parallel in herdr panes, each under its own clausona profile (another Claude Code or Codex account, or an API model such as GLM or DeepSeek), then watch them, check their work and retire them. Use when the user works in herdr and wants work spread across accounts or models, when one account's limits would slow a fan-out, or says "split this across my accounts in herdr", "run these on DeepSeek in herdr".

plugins/orca-fleet/skills/orca-fleet.description: Run several coding agents in parallel in Orca worktrees, each under its own clausona profile (another Claude Code or Codex account, or an API model such as GLM or DeepSeek), then watch them, check their work and retire them. Use when the user works in Orca and wants work spread across accounts or models, when one account's limits would slow a fan-out, or says "split this across my accounts in Orca", "run these on DeepSeek in Orca".

plugins/routing/skills/routing.description: Run Claude Code or Codex on whichever clausona account has quota left, using clausona routes, and create, change or explain those routes, and the dir rules and defaults that pick one for a plain `clausona run claude`, for the user. Use when the user says "run this on an account with room", "spread these across my accounts", "make a route of my work accounts", "use my work accounts in this repo", "why did it pick that account", "wait until an account frees up", when a run stops on a usage limit (of the plan or of one model, such as Opus), when writing a script or cron job that runs on a route,

plugins/superset-fleet/skills/superset-f.description: Run several coding agents in parallel in Superset workspaces, each under its own clausona profile (another Claude Code or Codex account, or an API model such as GLM or DeepSeek), then watch them, check their work and retire them. Use when the user wants work spread across accounts or models in Superset, when one account's limits would slow a fan-out, or says "split this across my accounts", "run these on GLM in Superset", "my account is near its limit, keep the workers going". Builds on superset:orchestrate.

plugins/tmux-fleet/skills/tmux-fleet.description: Run several coding agents in parallel in tmux windows, each under its own clausona profile (another Claude Code or Codex account, or an API model such as GLM or DeepSeek), then watch them, check their work and retire them. Use when the user works in tmux, on their own machine or over SSH, and wants work spread across accounts or models, when one account's limits would slow a fan-out, or says "split this across my accounts in tmux", "run these on DeepSeek in tmux windows".
